MATCHED-PAIR IRREDUCIBLE-NOISE BRACKET. Pairing rows on group, target hour and champion-action bin gives 5770 pairs with mean absolute difference D = 0.1405066 in capacity-fraction units, so the irreducible MAE floor lies in [0.0702533, 0.1405066].

The current champion MAE is 0.1409630, which is essentially equal to D itself. The champion is therefore performing at about the level of predicting with an independent draw from the same conditional law, i.e. at the UPPER end of the bracket.

The target MAE of 0.1203 lies strictly INSIDE the bracket. The accuracy axis is therefore NOT provably closed. The required 15 percent error reduction is not excluded by irreducible noise, and if the floor is near the lower bound there is room for roughly a 50 percent reduction.
Bias direction is favourable to this reading: conditioning on the champion action bin is a coarse proxy for conditioning on X, so D is biased UPWARD and the true floor is likely lower than measured.
